translation: The inner sinew is the xi (cleft) of the Yin Qiao, the Jiaoxin point. The Miaoci Lun (On Needling the Collaterals) of the Su wen says: When a pathogenic [influence] lodges in the vessel of the Foot Yang Qiao, it makes a person suffer eye pain, beginning from the inner canthus. Puncture at the place half a cun below the outer ankle with two points each (this is Shenmai), needling the left for the right and the right for the left, and [the disease] is settled after [a time] roughly like a person walking about ten li.
